landscape.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create finished premium App Store In-App Event artwork for Minor AI, a major release connecting AI chat, mind maps and presentations. Landscape 16:9, exactly 1920x1080 requested. Text-free universally localized event illustration, NOT a screenshot or UI mockup.
Concept: a conversation takes shape into a mind map and becomes a designed presentation. A sparse, sculptural mind map is the large central hero: one luminous ivory rounded rectangle root with two gracefully curving mint branches on the left and three clear branches on the right in sky blue, pale lilac and soft mint; only 9-12 nodes total, rounded pill-shaped frosted glass with thick sculpted edges. At left, two offset charcoal glass conversation bubbles with clean rounded silhouettes and small tails, entirely blank. At right, two overlapping wide 16:9 presentation sheets, one warm white foreground sheet with a beautiful simple three-step diagram of rounded mint blocks, one charcoal rear sheet with a lilac arc motif. No tiny details. These three subjects are visually connected with one flowing mint curve. Deliberate asymmetric editorial composition, central map dominates, chat and slide sheets are substantial enough to read at thumbnail size. Full scene occupies x 15%-85%, y 18%-73%; the lowest 22% has only quiet empty charcoal background for Apple's own metadata overlay.
Background solid charcoal #121212, very subtle fine dot pattern behind map only. Refined frosted translucent materials and restrained mint edge light #2FFF9E, white light #BBFFDF, branch colors #5EF0B0 #7CC4FF #C9A2FF. Sophisticated studio product illustration, near-frontal slight dimensional depth, incredibly crisp contours, confident restrained design. No rainbow, excessive neon or fog.
No typography, no letters, no numbers, no prices, no logos or brand mark, no watermarks, no phone mockup, no app controls, no fake interface, no frames or borders around the image, no added background gradients or bottom fade, no robots, brains, circuit boards, lens flares, hands or stock blobs. Do not draw Minor's logo. The finished art should look like an intentional campaign by a top editorial design studio.
